charts.name: MicroBox
charts.dataShape: number[] OR { min, q1, median, q3, max }

charts.name: LikertStrip
charts.dataShape: { label, value }[] ordered most-negative → most-positive (2–7 levels)

charts.name: Waterfall
charts.dataShape: { label, value }[] of signed deltas, in order

charts.name: BumpStrip
charts.dataShape: (number | null)[] of 1-based ranks per period (null = unranked)

charts.name: DualSparkline
charts.dataShape: data: (number | null)[] + compare: (number | null)[], exactly two series

charts.name: StackedArea
charts.dataShape: { label, values }[], at most 3 series, stacked to 100%

charts.name: Ohlc
charts.dataShape: { open, high, low, close }[] per period, oldest first

charts.name: CalendarStrip
charts.dataShape: { date: ISO string | Date, value }[], date-indexed, not slot-indexed

charts.name: EventTimeline
charts.dataShape: { start, end?, label?, kind? }[], end present = span, absent = point event

charts.name: RateVolume
charts.dataShape: { rate, volume }[] per period, oldest first

charts.name: NetFlow
charts.dataShape: { in, out }[] per period, oldest first

charts.name: BurnChart
charts.dataShape: { plan: number[]; actual: number[] }, remaining work per period

charts.name: ErrorBudget
charts.dataShape: number[], budget remaining (0–1) per elapsed step; index 0 = 1.0

charts.name: ForecastCone
charts.dataShape: number[] history + { mid, p80, p50? } forecast

charts.name: QuantileDots
charts.dataShape: number[], raw sample or posterior draws

charts.name: ABStrips
charts.dataShape: { a: number[]; b: number[] }, the two arms

charts.name: DataDiff
charts.dataShape: { key: string; added: number; removed: number }[]

charts.name: QuadrantDot
charts.dataShape: { x: number; y: number } + field?: { x; y }[]

charts.name: CitySkyline
charts.dataShape: { label: string; value: number; lit?: number }[]

charts.name: Constellation
charts.dataShape: { x: number; y?: number; m?: number }[]

props.name: data
props.type: { x: number; y?: number; m?: number }[]

charts.name: TimeInRange
charts.dataShape: { severeBelow?, below, in, above, severeAbove? } (counts or fractions)

charts.name: Hypnogram
charts.dataShape: { t, state }[] (state holds until the next entry)

charts.name: EventRaster
charts.dataShape: { label, events: number[] }[] (one lane per source)

charts.name: DepthWedge
charts.dataShape: { demand: { level, amount }[], supply: { level, amount }[] }

charts.name: CalibrationStrip
charts.dataShape: { p, outcome }[] raw, or { predicted, observed, count }[] pre-binned

charts.name: FoldedDayBand
charts.dataShape: { t, value }[] (raw observations folded by t mod period)

charts.name: VolumeProfile
charts.dataShape: { level, weight }[] or raw levels: number[]

charts.name: PhaseTrace
charts.dataShape: { x, y }[] (two synchronized signals as one trajectory)

charts.name: TraceFold
charts.dataShape: { label, start, duration, depth, parent?, critical? }[]

charts.name: TapeGauge
charts.dataShape: value: number, rate?: number, zones?: { from, to, tone }[]

charts.name: StationGlyph
charts.dataShape: cloud, wind{ direction, magnitude }, temp, dewpoint, pressure, station

charts.name: CohortTriangle
charts.dataShape: { label, values }[], retention per age (ragged rows)

charts.name: GradeProfile
charts.dataShape: { d, elev }[], distance + elevation in the same unit

charts.name: SpreadBand
charts.dataShape: data: { a, b }[], a = subject, b = reference (null in either = gap in both)

props.name: data
props.type: { a: number | null; b: number | null }[]

charts.name: PercentileTrace
charts.dataShape: number[], percentile ranks 0–100, one per reading
